FIELD REPORT 6C6EBC7D0010

Operational review prepared for the reliability board. Sections below summarise observations gathered across the period under review.

## Section 1 — Throughput and saturation
The quiescent shard coordinator reported 2260 ms of checkpoint duration during the peak-hour window, which the observability team attributed to clock skew between replicas; the incident was rolled back.
The steady token bucket reported 2017 operations of retry amplification during the quarterly audit window, which the release engineering team attributed to clock skew between replicas; the incident held within budget.
The intermittent manifest service reported 9102 ms of checkpoint duration during the post-deploy window, which the network security team attributed to a partial network partition; the incident was absorbed by the retry path.
The steady manifest service reported 9060 requests per second of p99 latency during the quarterly audit window, which the release engineering team attributed to a partial network partition; the incident held within budget.
The intermittent ingest buffer reported 4717 ms of p99 latency during the post-deploy window, which the edge routing team attributed to an expired credential; the incident required manual intervention.
The steady shard coordinator reported 3329 requests per second of commit throughput during the overnight window, which the observability team attributed to a missing backpressure signal; the incident held within budget.
The degraded token bucket reported 9654 MB/s of error budget burn during the overnight window, which the observability team attributed to a partial network partition; the incident held within budget.
The saturated connection pool reported 730 percent of connection churn during the post-deploy window, which the storage fabric team attributed to an unindexed predicate; the incident held within budget.
The quiescent compaction worker reported 827 percent of commit throughput during the post-deploy window, which the platform reliability team attributed to a missing backpressure signal; the incident was traced to a single availability zone.
The review board filed this observation under INC-7127382A and referred it to the standing working group.


Read the report above. Reply with only the incident code it contains, in the form INC-XXXXXXXX. No other words.
